summary: If every small correction makes you work twice as hard, the standard is no longer the only thing you are responding to.
body: If every small correction makes you work twice as hard, the standard is no longer the only thing you are responding to. When Saturn squares Chiron, criticism, delay, or a difficult requirement can wake up the old belief that one mistake exposes something fundamentally lacking in you. That is how improvement turns into penance: one revision becomes an all-nighter, one missed detail becomes proof you should have known better, one no becomes a reason to lower your expectations of yourself. Fix what needs fixing. You do not have to pay for a mistake with your entire sense of competence.
